title: Endo and Chiesa excluded from Liverpool's Champions League squad
summary: Liverpool has excluded midfielders Wataru Endo and Federico Chiesa from their UEFA Champions League squad. The specific reasons for their exclusion were not detailed in the coverage. Both players were notably absent from the team's roster for the upcoming competition.
summary_points: Wataru Endo and Federico Chiesa have been left out of Liverpool's Champions League squad.
The provided coverage does not specify the reasons for their exclusion.
